title: Understanding the Components
text: The expected squared error can be broken down into three main components: variance, bias squared, and irreducible error.

title: Irreducible Error
text: The term $${\sigma}^2$$ represents the irreducible error, which is the variance of the noise in the data.

title: Fixed or Variable?
text: Consider whether the irreducible error, represented by $${\sigma}^2$$, changes with different models or datasets.

title: Is $${\sigma}^2$$ fixed?
text: Determine if $${\sigma}^2$$ is a fixed value or if it varies with different models.
